step: Step 1: oracle ceiling and gate (training labels; diagnostic only)
preprocessing: zscore-train (refits: fitted on the kept rows)
oracle_cleaning: every training anomaly removed (training labels); the six members refitted on the normal training rows; test rows unchanged
fusion: E-all: min-max fitted on each member's training scores (kept rows for OC), then the mean (thesis.fusion.fuse, primary config)
k_rule: K = ceil(budget * n_test), at least 1 (metrics.budget_k); ties at the K-th score split in expectation
tie_rules: dataset outcome on seed means rounded to 9 decimals; best member ties: first in detector order (name only)

gate.rule: pass if all three hold: (1) OC E-all fewer false alarms than plain E-all on more datasets than the reverse (ties not counted); (2) mean FP@K of OC E-all at least 5% below plain E-all; (3) mean FP@K of OC E-all below plain IForest; (2) and (3) exact on the rounded means

note: training labels used only for oracle cleaning (diagnostic); test labels only for FP@K and the oracle references; refits kept in memory, not cached; ADBench only
